blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Text-to-Image models reproduce societal stereotypes, and existing mitigation applies one demographic correction to the whole scene. In multi-person scene generation this creates a trade-off: global steering improves aggregate balance only by homogenizing the people within an image. Steering-based methods like Embedding Arithmetic drive the intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline. Text- and latent-projection approaches shift the aggregate skew with only marginal gains in intra-image diversity. We present Spatially Gated Steering (SGS), which steers the demographics of each person independently by extracting per-person masks from the Diffusion Transformer's (DiT) internal attention maps at a critical denoising timestep and applying a distinct demographic vector within each mask for the remaining steps. SGS needs no fine-tuning, inversion or layout specifications, and uses a lightweight segmentor over frozen DiT attention features to localize subjects at early timesteps. On skewed occupational prompts, SGS reaches high intra-image racial and gender diversity while keeping aggregate balance competitive and image quality near baseline, a result we validate on two architecturally distinct diffusion transformers, FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large. Codebase and model weights are available at https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering
blocks.zh: 文字到图像模型复制了社会定型观念,而现有的缓解措施将一种人口矫正应用于整个场景。 在多人场景的生成中,这创造了一种取舍:全球取向只通过将画面内的人同化来改善总量平衡. 以"嵌入"算术"等以指导为主的方法,将图像内部多样性推向了未被测出基线以下. 文字和潜在预测方法转移了总汇,在图像内多样性方面只有微小收益。 我们提出空间定位指导(SGS),它通过在关键的解点时间步骤中从传播变形器内部注意力图中提取每人口罩,并在每个口罩中为其余步骤应用一个独特的人口载体,独立地指导每个人的人口结构。 SGS不需要微调,倒置或布局规格,并使用轻量级分管比起被冷冻的DiT注意力特性来在早期将被子本地化. 在扭曲的职业提示下,SGS达到了高度的图像内种族和性别多样性,同时保持了总体平衡的竞争力和图像质量接近基线,我们验证了两个结构上独特的扩散变压器,即FLUX.1-Dev和SD3.5-Large。 代码基础和模型权重可在https://github.com/cvims/spatially-gated-steering上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Text-to-Image (T2I) generation has transformed digital content creation, yet foundational models such as FLUX [ 24 ] and Stable Diffusion [ 10 ] systematically reproduce societal stereotypes [ 9 ] .
Gender-neutral prompts like a carpenter yield predominantly male-presenting images; a nurse yields predominantly female-presenting images [ 28 ] .
Studies show these outputs shift user beliefs about real-world distributions [ 14 ] , making fairness mitigation essential for responsible deployment.

不分性别的提示,如木匠产生以男性为主的图像;护士产生以女性为主的图像[28]。
研究表明,这些产出改变了用户对现实世界分布的信念[14],使公平缓解对于负责任的部署至关重要。

Several mitigation strategies have been proposed and they operate at different levels of the diffusion pipeline [ 37 ] : They modify the text embeddings [ 39 , 6 , 43 , 22 ] or fine-tune model weights [ 13 , 36 ] to shift the aggregate output distribution.
While effective for scenes with a single person, global mitigation methods share a fundamental limitation: They apply identical steering to every person in a scene.
A prompt like ”a group of nurses” receives one demographic vector, pushing all the persons in the image in the same direction and failing to diversify individuals independently.

像“一群护士”这样迅速接受一个人口载体,将形象中的所有人推向同一个方向,未能使个人独立多样化。

blocks.en: This limitation is not merely theoretical: Wan and Chang [41] show that multi-person prompts expose a distinct, compounding class of bias that single-subject evaluations cannot capture. Co-occurring subjects amplify stereotypes even when the same model behaves anti-stereotypically on single-person prompts.
blocks.zh: 这一限制不仅仅是理论上的:Wan and Chang [41] 显示多人提示暴露了单主体评价无法捕捉到的明显,复合的偏见类别. 共同参与的课题会扩大陈规定型观念,即使同一模式在单人提示上表现出反定型。

blocks.en:
Attempts to address this gap remain limited. Existing approaches either rewrite the generation prompt with a single corrective signal applied to the whole scene [ 41 , 8 ] , optimize demographic distributions at the aggregate level without per-instance control [ 18 ] , or require an explicit spatial layout as input [ 7 ] .
To the best of our knowledge, no existing method localizes individuals from the model’s own internal representations and applies independent demographic steering, to achieve intra-image diversity.
Figure 1 illustrates this gap: while global mitigation shifts all persons uniformly toward a single demographic mode, our approach steers each individual independently through their spatial mask, reaching distinct attractors within p data p_{\text{data}} in a single denoising pass.
blocks.zh:

据我们所知,目前没有一种方法能将个人从模型本身的内部表述中本地化,并应用独立的人口指导,以实现图像内部的多样性。
图1说明了这一差距:虽然全球缓解措施将所有人统一转向单一的人口模式,但我们的做法通过空间遮罩将每个人独立引导,在p数据 p_{\text{data}} 中以单一的去名通道达到不同的吸引者。

blocks.en:
We introduce Spatially Gated Steering (SGS) , a framework for per-instance demographic steering in multi-person T2I scene generation.
SGS operates by 1) Identifying and generating the masks of instances of people during the intermediate denoising steps using a lightweight detector, 2) Steering the demographics of the detected individuals, while also maintaining concept coherence.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了空间Gated Direction(SGS),即多人T2I场景生成中每层人口引导的框架.
SGS的运作方式是:1)使用轻量级探测器识别和生成中间解密步骤期间的人的口罩,2)指导被检测个人的人口统计,同时保持概念的一致性.

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en:
• A trade-off in multi-person fairness. Global mitigation faces an inherent tension: improving aggregate balance requires collapsing intra-image diversity, sometimes below the unsteered baseline.
Since any per-instance diversification trivially raises intra-image entropy, the meaningful result is high entropy at a competitive aggregate balance.
SGS reaches high intra-image diversity with a competitive aggregate balance by steering per-instance without fine-tuning, flow-inversion or layout. • Instance segmentation from DiT features. We show that self-attention maps of DiTs at a critical denoising timestep encode spatially separable person instances, and train a lightweight DETR-style [ 4 ] segmentor on these frozen features that isolates individuals across crowd sizes and scene complexities. • Benchmark and analysis. We introduce a benchmark measuring fairness along both intra-image diversity and aggregate deviation, surfacing the homogenization failure mode of global methods and showing SGS is strong on both axes, on both FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large.

由于任何偶发性多样化都微不足道地提高了形象内质素,因此在竞争性的总平衡下,有意义的结果是高质素。
SGS通过在不进行微调,流量反转或布局的情况下,通过引导每局实现具有竞争力的总量平衡,达到图像内高度多样性. • 从DiT特性中分离实例。 我们显示,DiTs在关键的解点时间步上的自觉地图 编码了空间可分离的人物实例,并训练一个轻量级的DETR型 [4] 分区器,这些冻结的特征将个人隔离在人群大小和场景复杂性上. • 基准和分析。 我们采用了一个衡量图像内多样性和总偏差的公平性的基准,表面展现了全球方法的同质化故障模式,并显示SGS在FLUX.1-Dev和SD3.5-Large这两个轴上都很强。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en:
T2I models have been extensively shown to amplify demographic stereotypes encoded in training data, producing outputs skewed by gender, race and cultural identity across a wide range of prompt types [ 1 , 5 , 35 , 28 ] .
Beyond documenting these skews, a parallel line of work formalizes their measurement: Dehdashtian et al. [ 9 ] quantify stereotypical attributes in the generated set and trace their origin within the model, reporting that even high-fidelity systems such as FLUX retain strong stereotypical predispositions.
Mitigation strategies operate at different points in the generation pipeline: prompt engineering injects demographic descriptors at inference [ 11 , 2 , 43 ] , embedding manipulation steers text representations prior to image generation [ 39 , 6 , 22 , 25 , 26 , 15 ] , and parameter-efficient fine-tuning edits model weights to shift output distributions [ 13 , 36 ] .
Park et al.’s Entanglement-Free Attention [ 30 ] shares our goal of preserving non-target attributes during bias mitigation, training cross-attention predictors under a mask-constrained regularization loss so background edits are suppressed.
However, like other global methods, it applies one scene-level attribute correction rather than steering each person independently.
Despite this breadth, all existing methods treat the generated image as a single unit, applying one steering signal to the entire scene.
This is sufficient when a prompt produces one person, but breaks down entirely for multi-person scenes where distinct individuals require independent control.
blocks.zh:
T2I模式被广泛显示为在培训数据中扩大人口定型观念,在各种迅速类型[1、5、35、28]中产生因性别、种族和文化特征而扭曲的产出。
除了记录这些skews外,并行的工作线还正式确定了它们的测量:Dehdashtian等人。 [9] 量化生成的集合中的定型属性,并追踪其来源于模型,报告甚至FLUX等高性能系统仍然保留着强烈的定型倾向.
缓解策略在生成管道的不同点运行: 迅速工程在推论中注入人口描述符 [11, 2, 43],嵌入操控在图像生成前引导文本表达 [39, 6, 22, 25, 26, 15], 参数高效的微调编辑模型权重以转移输出分布 [13, 36].
Park et al.的 " 缠绕-无拘束的注意 " [30] 与我们的目标一致,即在减轻偏见时保持非目标属性,在遮罩限制的正规化损失下培训跨目标预测器,从而压制背景编辑。
然而,与其他全球方法一样,它采用了一个场景级属性校正,而不是独立引导每个人.
尽管有这种宽度,所有现有的方法都将生成的图像作为一个单单元处理,将一个方向信号应用到整个场景.
当一个瞬间产生一个人时,这就足够了,但完全为了多人的场景而崩溃,因为不同的个人需要独立的控制。

blocks.en:
This breakdown in multi-subject generation is primarily driven by semantic leakage, a phenomenon where the attention mechanisms of diffusion architectures inadvertently blend the visual and demographic features of different subjects during the denoising trajectory. Wan and Chang [41] demonstrate the consequences of this at scale: their Paired Stereotype Test shows that over 74% of DALL-E 3 images depicting two individuals with contrastive social identities display gender-occupational biases, even when the same model produces anti-stereotypical outputs for single-person prompts. Jung et al. [18] propose a Multi-Group Proportional Representation metric to measure and optimize demographic distributions across intersectional groups, but operate at the aggregate level without per-instance control.
A related direction targets stereotypes that emerge from the co-occurrence of multiple concepts within a single prompt: Zhou et al. [47] show that pairing a demographic descriptor with an unrelated object can induce stereotypical associations invisible to single-concept audits, mitigated via a trained Sensitive Transformer that constrains the output distribution toward a stereotype-free target. This targets a distinct problem from ours, stereotyped associations between a subject and its surrounding context, corrected globally over the whole generation, rather than diversifying multiple people already explicitly present in a scene.
Training-free inference methods such as Bounded Attention [ 7 ] attempt to prevent semantic leakage by confining attention flows within manually predefined spatial bounding boxes, but rely on rigid user-provided layouts rather than organic scene composition. Reinforcement learning approaches such as DisCo [ 3 ] directly fine-tune models to penalize intra-image facial similarity, but use face similarity as a proxy for demographic diversity rather than steering specific attribute vectors, and incur significant computational overhead.
Global steering techniques such as Embedding Arithmetic [ 39 ] modify text embeddings uniformly, which fundamentally fails to produce heterogeneous intra-image diversity.
blocks.zh:
在多主体生成中这种分解主要是由语义性渗漏所驱动的,这一现象是扩散结构的注意力机制在去诺化轨迹中无意中将不同主体的视觉特征和人口特征融合在一起. Wan和Chang[41]从规模上证明了其后果:他们的Paired 定型 测试显示,超过74%的DALL-E 3图像描绘了两个具有不同社会身份的个人表现出性别职业偏见,即使同一模型为单人提示产生反定型输出。 郑等. [18] 提出一个多组比例代表指标,以衡量和优化交叉组别之间的人口分布,但在总体水平上运行,不进行逐一控制.
一个相关的方向针对在单一瞬间内同时出现多种概念所产生的陈规定型观念: 周 et等编. [47] 表明将人口描述与不相关的对象配对,可诱发对单一概念审计视而不见的陈规定型联系,通过训练有素的敏感变形器加以缓解,这种变形器将限制产出分配,使之朝向无定型目标。 这个问题不同于我们的问题,一个主题与其周围背景之间的定型联系,它在全球一代人中得到了纠正,而不是使已经明确出现在某一场景中的多种人多样化。
Brunded Content [7]等无训练推论方法试图通过将注意力流限制在手动预定义的空间边框内来防止语义渗漏,但依赖于刚性用户提供的布局而不是有机场景构成. DisCo[3]等强化学习方法直接微调模型,以惩罚图像内面部相似性,但使用面部相似性作为人口多样性的代名词,而不是引导特定属性矢量,并产生大量的计算间接费用.
全球引导技术,如嵌入算术[39] 统一修改嵌入文本,这根本无法产生不同图像内部的多样性。

blocks.en:
Intermediate diffusion activations encode rich spatial structure without additional training: DIFT [ 38 ] shows mid-denoising U-Net features support zero-shot dense correspondence; ODISE [ 42 ] uses Stable Diffusion U-Net features for open-vocabulary panoptic segmentation.
This extends to Diffusion Transformers only recently: ConceptAttention [ 16 ] shows DiT attention-layer projections yield sharper concept saliency than cross-attention alone; TRACE [ 17 ] shows diffusion models isolate object boundaries at a specific timestep, enabling spatial masks from internal attention.
SGS extends this line of work to intra-image demographic fairness in multi-person scenes generated by T2I models.
blocks.zh:
中间扩散激活编码丰富空间结构而无需额外训练: DIFT [38] 显示中识别的U-Net特性支持零射致密通信; ODISE [42] 使用Stable Difusion U-Net特性进行开源光谱分割.
这直到最近才扩展到扩散变形器:概念注意[16] 显示DiT的注意级预测比单是交叉注意更突出的概念;TRACE[17]显示扩散模型在特定时间段将物体边界隔离,使空间口罩能够从内部注意.
SGS在T2I模型生成的多人场景中将本行延伸至图像内部人口公平.

blocks.en: 4 Methods
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
SGS performs per-instance demographic steering within the standard rectified flow denoising loop, requiring no model fine-tuning, no trajectory inversion, and no external spatial layout specification.
Crucially, instance masks are predicted directly from the MM-DiT’s attention features at a critical denoising step, rather than decoding the noisy latents for an external segmentor - which would be unreliable while the latent is still far from x 0 x_{0} , and redundant since these features are already computed by the base pass.
Figure 1 illustrates the intuition behind our approach and Algorithm 1 summarizes the complete inference procedure.
The denoising loop is divided into three phases governed by two hyperparameters: t start t_{\mathrm{start}} and t end t_{\mathrm{end}} .
Before t start t_{\mathrm{start}} , generation proceeds without intervention.
At t start t_{\mathrm{start}} , instance masks are extracted and cached.
Between t start t_{\mathrm{start}} and t end t_{\mathrm{end}} , a separate steered forward pass is run per detected instance at each denoising step, and the predictions are spatially accumulated.
After t end t_{\mathrm{end}} , standard denoising resumes to completion.

blocks.en:
Our primary experiments use FLUX.1-Dev 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev in bfloat16 precision [ 19 ] on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU (48GB VRAM), with 21 denoising steps and a guidance scale of 4.5.
To evaluate cross-architecture generalization, we additionally port SGS and all four baselines to SD3.5-Large 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stable-diffusion-3.5-large in bfloat16 precision, run on a single NVIDIA A100 GPU (39GB MIG slice), at 1024 × 1024 1024{\times}1024 resolution (its native training resolution) with 28 denoising steps and a guidance scale of 3.5.
SGS’s instance-detection and per-instance steering mechanism (Section 4.1 , Section 3.3 ) makes no FLUX-specific assumption beyond the existence of a joint image-text self-attention map inside the denoising transformer, which SD3.5’s MM-DiT also provides.
SD3.5-Large’s EA direction vectors live in the joint pooled embedding of its two CLIP encoders (CLIP-L and CLIP-G, concatenated to 2048-dim), rather than FLUX’s single 768-dim CLIP-L pooled space; T5 remains excluded from vector construction in both cases.

blocks.en: 5.6 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5.6 人类评价

blocks.en: The metrics above rely on an automatic race/gender classifier (Section 5.1 ). To check that SGS’s gains are also visible to real people, not just to one automatic tool, we ran a small anonymous online study. Raters were shown two images side by side, one from SGS and one from a baseline, and asked which has more diverse people and which better matches the prompt, plus an overall preference. We collected 65 completed sessions (657 screens, 1971 judgments in total), comparing SGS against all five baselines.
blocks.zh: 上述衡量标准依靠自动种族/性别分类(第5.1节)。 为了检查SGS的成绩是否也可见于真实的人, Raters被同时显示两幅图像,一张来自SGS,一张来自基线,并询问哪幅图片具有更多样化的人,哪些图片更符合提示,再加上总体偏好. 我们收集了65次已完成的会议(共计657次屏幕,1971年判决),将最高安全标准与所有五个基线进行比较。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the share of judgments that favored SGS. Raters preferred SGS on diversity by a wide margin against every baseline (88–90%, all differences statistically significant). On matching the prompt, results are mostly a tie, except SGS is clearly preferred over EA (89%). The overall preference question shows the same pattern: SGS is clearly favored over EA (76%) and roughly tied with the rest. Agreement between raters (Krippendorff’s alpha, where 1.0 means perfect agreement and 0 means no better than chance) was 0.73 for diversity – strong agreement – and lower, 0.43–0.44, for the more subjective faithfulness/preference questions, which is expected for personal-taste judgments. Full study design, recruiting, and per-question detail are in the supplementary material (Section O ).

This cost is proportional to the scene complexity and can be reduced by narrowing the steering window at the expense of steering accuracy (Table S6 , supplementary Section H ).

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en:
Three limitations bound the current system.
First, segmentor accuracy degrades for k ≥ 4 k{\geq}4 persons in heavily occluded scenes, this also impacts the steering accuracy.
Second, the per-instance forward pass introduces a compute overhead proportional to K K .
Batching would reduce wall-clock time at the cost of VRAM, a trade-off we could not explore within our hardware budget.
Third, SGS applies steering regardless of prompt intent; a query such as “four male doctors” will still redistribute demographics. A lightweight prompt parser that zeroes the steering signal for explicitly constrained slots could address this.

第二,每名前方通行证引入与KK成比例的计算费。
我们无法在硬件预算范围内进行权衡。
第三,社会保障系统不论意向如何都采用指导方法;“四名男医生”等查询仍将重新分配人口统计。 一个轻量级的即时解析器,对明确受限槽的引导信号进行零化,可以解决这个问题。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SGS, a per-instance demographic steering framework for multi-person T2I generation requiring no fine-tuning, inversion, or layout input.
Global steering improves aggregate balance only by driving intra-image diversity below the unsteered baseline; SGS is the only evaluated method to break this trade-off, raising intersectional entropy to 0.794 (from 0.524) on FLUX.1-Dev and to 0.832 (from 0.549) on SD3.5-Large, while recovering near-best aggregate balance and preserving semantic coherence on both architectures.
Per-instance spatial steering thus emerges as a necessary step toward fair multi-person text-to-image generation, generalizing across architecturally distinct diffusion transformers rather than being a property of any single model.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了SGS,这是多人T2I一代的每层人口指导框架,不需要微调、反转或布局投入。
全球引导只能通过将图像内部多样性推向未定基线以下来改善总量平衡; SGS是打破这种权衡的唯一被评价的方法,将FLUX.1-Dev上的交叉演算式提高到0.794(从0.524),将SD3.5-Large上的交叉演算式提高到0.832(从0.549),同时恢复近乎最佳的总量平衡,并保持两种架构的语义一致性.
因此,人际空间引导成为实现公平的多人文字对图像生成的一个必要步骤,它跨越建筑上独特的传播变压器,而不是任何单一模型的财产。

blocks.en: Appendix E Classifier Validation
blocks.zh: 附录E 分类符验证

blocks.en:
All race/gender numbers in this paper depend on one automatic tool, FairFace [ 20 ] .
To read demographics off a generated face, before trusting it, we check how accurate it actually is against a set of images where the true demographic is known for certain, and we also check two other classifiers (a CLIP [ 31 ] zero-shot classifier, and DeepFace [ 34 ] ) for comparison.
blocks.zh:
本文中所有种族/性别编号都取决于一个自动工具,FairFace [20].
从一个生成的面孔上读出人口统计数据, 在信任它之前, 我们检查它是否与一组真实的人口构成 已知的图像相对应, 我们还检查另外两个分类器(一个CLIP [31] 零镜头分类器, 和DeepFace [34])进行比较。

blocks.en:
We generate images where every person in the group is asked for the same demographic (e.g. “a group of three Black women”), so the prompt itself has a cue for every face in that image.
This is done for both FLUX.1-Dev and SD3.5-Large, across all 8 race × \times gender combinations and group sizes k ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 } k\in\{2,3,4\} . We keep only images where a face detector actually finds exactly k k faces, to avoid mixing in blank or wrong-count images; this leaves 1,832 individual face crops with a known-correct label.

我们生成图象,要求该团体中的每一个人(例如“三个黑人妇女小组”)保持同样的人口结构,因此,该图象中的每个面都有一个提示。

FairFace and CLIP are both highly accurate on race (95–96%) and near-perfect on gender ( > > 99%); DeepFace is noticeably weaker on race (88%) and gender (93%). “Abstain” means the classifier’s raw output fell into a category we do not use (e.g. Middle Eastern, Latino/Hispanic, dropped due to high confusion with other categories reported in several previous works [ 39 , 36 ] ); this happens occasionally for FairFace and DeepFace and never for CLIP, which only ever outputs one of our four race categories directly.

blocks.en:
Figure 5 compares instance segmentation predictions across four scenes spanning easy to hard difficulty.
In the simpler market and tourist scenes ( rows 1–2 ), all methods recover the correct instance count, though K-Means and Spectral clustering exhibit scattered noise pixels caused by high-frequency variation in the attention feature space.
The gap widens in the close-up street scene and the outdoor hikers scene ( rows 3–4 ): K-Means and Spectral produce heavily fragmented masks that merge or split individuals, while CenterNet over-estimates the instance count due to ambiguous overlap regions.
DETR-based segmentor produces coherent per-person masks with the correct instance counts, demonstrating that the cross-attention mechanism of DETR learns to separate spatially proximate instances that confound clustering-based approaches.
blocks.zh:
图5比较了四个场景的实例分解预测,这些预测跨越了容易到困难的场景。
在更简单的市场和旅游场景(第1–2行)中,所有方法都恢复了正确的实例计数,尽管K-Means和Spectraral Crouping展出了由注意力特征空间的高频变化引起的零散噪声像素.
在特写街景和户外徒步者场景(第3–4行)中差距扩大:K-Means和Spectral产生高度分散的口罩,将个人合并或分裂,而CentreNet则由于模糊的重叠区域而高估了案例计数.
基于DETR的片段器产生连贯的每人口罩,并有正确的实例计数,表明DETR的交叉留念机制学习分离空间近似的,混淆了基于集群的方法.

blocks.en:
A key requirement of practical fairness steering is that demographic edits do not disrupt occupational cues.
Across all conditions, SGS preserves the visual markers of each profession: nurses retain scrubs and stethoscopes, sheriffs retain badges and hats, housekeepers retain aprons, and construction workers retain safety helmets and reflective vests.
This confirms that the spatially gated steering is confined to person regions via the instance masks, preventing demographic steering from leaking into occupational attire or scene background.
blocks.zh:
实际公平指导的一个关键要求是人口编辑不会扰乱职业提示。
在所有条件下,SGS都保留了每个专业的视觉标记:护士保留着擦拭和听诊镜,警长保留着徽章和帽子,管家保留着围裙,建筑工人保留着安全头盔和反光背心.
这证实,空间锁定的导线通过实例口罩限于人的区域,防止人口引导渗入职业服装或场景背景。

blocks.zh: 附录N 适应扩散变压器的基线

blocks.en: FairImagen [ 12 ] , SDID [ 25 ] , and RespoDiff [ 40 ] were each designed and released against older UNet-based diffusion models – FairImagen against SD1.5 and SDXL, RespoDiff against SDXL, and SDID against a UNet-based Stable Diffusion pipeline – where generation is driven by a single-stream convolutional UNet with cross-attention to a text encoder. FLUX and SD3.5-Large instead use a Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT, Section 3.2 ): image and text tokens are processed jointly through a stack of self-attention blocks, with no UNet and no single bottleneck layer. None of the three methods’ released implementations run on this architecture family as-is. We faithfully reimplemented each method’s core mechanism for MM-DiT, verified directly against its own released code, rather than mechanically porting UNet-specific hooks.

blocks.en: Appendix O Human Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录O 人类评价议定书

blocks.en:
Automatic demographic classifiers may not fully capture how a human observer perceives diversity, prompt fidelity and preference.
So we conducted a blind pairwise human evaluation comparing SGS against five baselines (Baseline, EA, FairImagen, RespoDiff and SDID) across 33 scenes spanning WinoBias occupations at K ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 } K\in\{2,3,4\} people per image, using a fixed seed per scene shared across all six methods.
Each rater was shown two images side by side from the same scene, generated by two different methods (one always SGS), with method identity withheld (labeled only ’Image A’/’Image B’) and left – right placement randomized per pair.
For each pair, raters answered three questions (refer Figure 9 ): 1. Which image shows more diversity in race and gender? 2. Which image better matches the caption above? 3. Given a choice, which image would you prefer? The first two questions offered a three way choice (Image A / about equal / Image B), while the last was a forced binary choice used to obtain a holistic preference signal.
Each participants rated 10 pairs, two per comparison, ensuring balanced coverage across all five comparisons within a session.
blocks.zh:
自动人口分类法可能无法充分反映人类观察者如何看待多样性、即时忠诚和偏好。
因此,我们进行了盲目对人的评价,将SGS比作5个基线(Baseline、EA、FairImagen、RespoDiff和SDID),覆盖了K {{{2、3、4}K\\\2、3、4}的33个WinoBias职业场景,使用所有六种方法共享的每个场景的固定种子。
每个评分器都从同一个场景中被同时显示两个图像,由两种不同的方法生成(一个总是SGS),方法身份被扣(仅标注 " Image A " / " Image B " ),左侧(右位位置随机排列).
每对,评分者回答三个问题(参见图9): 1. 哪些形象显示种族和性别更加多样化? 2. 哪些图像更符合上面的标题? 3. 如果有选择,你喜欢哪种形象? 前两个问题提供了三种选择方式(Image A / about equal / Image B),而最后一个问题则是强迫二进制选择,用于获得整体偏好信号.
每个参与者评分为10对,每对比较2对,确保会议内所有五个比较的覆盖面均衡。

blocks.en:
Sessions in which a rater selected the identical response to every question throughout were excluded prior to analysis.
For each comparison and question, we report the percentage of judgments preferring SGS (ties counted as half a preference) with a 95% Wilson score confidence interval and a two-sided exact binomial test against the 50% chance level (ties excluded from the significance test), alongside Krippendorff’s α \alpha (nominal) as a measure of inter-rater reliability [ 23 ] ; results are reported in Table 2 .

对于每一个比较和问题,我们报告倾向于SGS(按半优先计算)的判断百分比,其中95%的威尔逊评分置信间隔和对50%的概率水平的双侧精确二进制测试(不包括在意义测试之外),以及Krippendorff的α-alpha(名义)作为衡量战略间可靠性的标准[23];结果见表2。
